fields.description: Lower numbers run first when syncing all configurations.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Include this configuration in scheduled runs.
fields.label: Scheduler Enabled
Sync Interval (Minutes)
fields.description: How often the scheduler runs this configuration. The scheduler ticks every 15 minutes, so use 15, 30, 60, 360 or 1440 (daily). Use a long interval for large Full-mode DocTypes.

fields.label: Cursor Safety Lag (Seconds)
fields.description: Incremental runs re-read records modified this long before the saved position, to catch transactions that committed late. Raise it if long imports or submits run on this DocType.

Run OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL after each sync so the ClickHouse table holds exactly one physical row per record (latest version). Disable for very large tables where the rewrite cost is significant; query with FINAL instead.
fields.label: Optimize After Sync

fields.description: Only run OPTIMIZE after Full syncs, never after Incremental. Recommended for large, frequently-synced tables so incremental ticks don't trigger a full-table rewrite each time.
fields.label: Optimize Only On Full Sync

fields.description: Also reconcile deletes on Incremental syncs (compares the full name set against the source). Catches deletions the real-time hook can miss - rows deleted while a sync was down, bulk or direct-DB deletes. Adds a full name scan per run, so enable it for tables where delete accuracy matters more than sync speed. No effect when Delete Strategy is Ignore.
fields.label: Reconcile Deletes On Incremental

fields.description: Also sync this DocType's child tables (grid rows like invoice line items) into their own ClickHouse tables, joinable back via the parent column. Follows this configuration's sync mode and exclusions.
fields.label: Sync Child Tables
Partition By Creation Month
fields.description: For large DocTypes: partition the ClickHouse table by creation month so post-sync OPTIMIZE rewrites only the months a run touched. Applies when the table is created; to apply it to an existing table, drop the table and run a Full sync.
How to treat rows deleted in Frappe but still in ClickHouse.
fields.label: Delete Strategy

fields.description: Fields removed from the ClickHouse table entirely (personal/sensitive columns). Use the 'Select Fields to Exclude' button under Privacy to pick them from a list rather than typing.
fields.label: Excluded Fields

fields.description: Incremental cursor. Rows modified at/after this are re-synced.
fields.label: Last Sync Timestamp
